title: Happy chameleon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail curl -->
  <path d='M26 62 C18 60 14 52 18 46 C22 40 30 40 32 46 C34 51 30 55 26 53' fill='none' stroke='#5ad16b' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='56' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#3fbf5a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='61' rx='14' ry='7' fill='#9be88f'/>
  <!-- back crest dots -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='44' r='3' fill='#1e8f3f'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='45' r='3' fill='#1e8f3f'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='45' r='3' fill='#1e8f3f'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M36 68 L33 78 L27 78' fill='none' stroke='#2fa04a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M54 68 L57 78 L63 78' fill='none' stroke='#2fa04a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='44' r='14' fill='#4fcf6a'/>
  <!-- casque -->
  <path d='M60 34 C66 22 78 22 82 32 C76 30 68 32 64 38 Z' fill='#2fa04a'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='6' fill='#e8ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='42' r='3.2' fill='#123c1e'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='41' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M76 50 Q81 55 86 49' fill='none' stroke='#1e7f3a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue tip -->
  <path d='M84 48 Q92 44 94 47' fill='none' stroke='#ff6f9c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#ff6f9c'/>
</svg>
